# OnerOS

> OnerOS is an open-source, web-based operating system experience. It features window management, 7 visual themes (Fluent Valley, Modern, Centered, Win95, WinXP, macOS, Ubuntu), built-in applications, and a Spotlight-style global search -- all running in the browser. The project is built with Vite, vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript, and has zero runtime dependencies. Created by Klubuntu (https://klubuntu.eu.org).

## Try It Live

- [OnerOS Web Preview 3.1.0](https://web-oneros.netlify.app): The live, fully interactive OnerOS experience in your browser

## Official Website

- [OnerOS Website](https://oneros.in): Product website with features, theme showcase, app previews, and ecosystem overview

## Documentation

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/OnerOS-project): Source code, issues, releases, and project overview
- [Contributing](https://github.com/OnerOS-Project/Web-Preview/pulls): Submit pull requests and help improve OnerOS

## Ecosystem

- [ReVideeo](https://revideeo.app): Open-source video editor, media application in the OnerOS ecosystem
- [ReImaage](https://reimaage-app.vercel.app/): Open-source image editor, media application in the ecosystem
- [iVOD](https://vod.itvt.xyz): Video-on-demand platform, VOD and live broadcast
